reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: SQLite driver better-sqlite3. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only; an embedded file database does not survive in the container model.
reviews.reason: Nothing shown selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead of the better-sqlite3 driver, so the sync server appears to keep its data in SQLite files.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./actual-data:/data (packages/sync-server/docker-compose.yml actual_server)
reviews.reason: The image creates /data, the compose file mounts a durable volume there, and no shown setting moves this data to S3 or a database.
